scientific_integrity: The theorem is analytically proved; CHECK.py provides independent finite implementation checks, not proof of all-order quantifiers. The 2015 graph Vandermonde framework is credited. No independent external mathematical audit or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only normalized adjacency on an unweighted path, lowpass subspace, one sensor, m consecutive times and determinant design. The general n >= ceil(3 m^(3/2)) sufficient threshold is not claimed sharp; full text of 2026 arXiv motivating paper was unavailable.
title: Exact low-bandwidth sensor migration on normalized paths
